description: Edges have a direction. Here `a → b` means "a depends on b"; always state the convention.
Directed acyclic graph: no path leads back to its start. Only DAGs have a topological order.
Each node maps to the nodes it points to: `Record<string, string[]>` or `Map<string, string[]>`.
A list where every node comes after all of its dependencies. Several valid orders usually exist.
Unvisited, visiting (on the current path), done. Reaching a visiting node reveals a cycle and its exact path.
Repeatedly take the nodes with no unmet dependencies. Taking them level by level yields waves that can run in parallel.
